features: 【📱 Ultra-Portable Foldable Design for Travel】Designed for professionals on the move, Acer MiniFold features an innovative folding structure that easily fits into backpacks, handbags, and laptop sleeves. Its compact folded size and lightweight 149g design make it the perfect travel companion for productivity anywhere.

【🔗 Bluetooth 5.0 Wireless Connectivity】Enjoy stable and efficient wireless connectivity with advanced Bluetooth 5.0 technology. Pair seamlessly with smartphones, tablets, laptops, and desktops while maintaining reliable performance and reduced power consumption for everyday work and entertainment.

【⌨️ 66-Key Compact Layout with Multimedia Shortcuts】The optimized 66-key layout delivers comfortable typing while saving desk space. Dedicated multimedia shortcuts through FN combinations provide quick access to volume, playback controls, brightness adjustments, screenshots, search functions, and more for enhanced productivity.

【🔋 Rechargeable Battery with Up to 40 Hours Usage】Powered by a built-in 150mAh rechargeable lithium battery, Acer MiniFold offers up to 40 hours of continuous usage on a single charge. USB Type-C fast charging and intelligent auto-sleep functionality help maximize battery efficiency throughout the day.

【💻 Universal Compatibility Across Multiple Platforms】Switch effortlessly between Windows, Android, and Apple devices using dedicated system shortcuts. Compatible with laptops, tablets, smartphones, PCs, and other Bluetooth-enabled devices, making it ideal for work, study, travel, and remote productivity.
